name: GET /api/consents/export - Export consent receipts for a person

testCases.name: Export receipts for the freshly-registered person
Refuse an export with no subject - this endpoint is not a register

description:
Exports the receipts THIS TENANT holds for ONE subject, as a JSONL-friendly array under { data: { receipts } } with status 200 - the DSAR / Article-15 surface. person_id is REQUIRED and the read is scoped to the tenant on the credential.

BOTH OF THOSE ARE CHANGES, AND THE OLD BEHAVIOUR WAS A DISCLOSURE. person_id used to be optional: omitting it returned the most recent thousand receipts belonging to EVERY tenant on the platform, and supplying one returned that person's receipts from every tenant they had ever dealt with - so the endpoint whose purpose is answering a subject-access request was the one assembling a cross-controller profile of the subject. LeadFlow's consent register called it with no person filter and rendered another tenant's receipts as its own. A caller that wants its own register wants GET /api/consents/receipts, which is a different question with a different shape.

Edge cases: an unknown person_id returns 200 with an empty receipts array rather than a 404, and a person in another tenant is indistinguishable from an unknown one, which is the point; revoked and expired receipts are included (this is a full history, not a live-consent view); the export is unpaginated, bounded in practice by one subject's receipt count; requires a valid JWT carrying a tenant.

errorCases.message: person_id is required — this endpoint answers a subject access request
errorCases.when: person_id is absent or blank. Deliberately NOT a defaulted export-everything: that default was the leak.

errorCases.message: This token carries no tenant, so no receipt scope can be derived
errorCases.when: the credential verifies but carries no tenant claim. Matches the rule the point-read route already applies: an unscoped receipt query is not a broad answer, it is somebody else's answer.
Authorization header absent or not in Bearer form (requireAuth / gateway default-deny authGate)
Bearer token fails JWT verification or is expired (requireAuth / gateway default-deny authGate)
exportReceipts throws - includes a non-UUID person_id (Postgres 22P02) and database errors
